messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty page triggered: HIGH - elevated 5xx rate on /v1/generate (release: hotfix-2026-03-14). PD incident: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/PD12345 :rotating_light:

pagerduty: page fired to sam (oncall) and escalation policy 'prod-sre'.

sam (oncall): acked the page. I'm looking. Seeing spike in 5xxs from model-runtime in dedicated-gpu pool (gpu-pool-42).

sam (oncall): quick checks - metrics dashboard: 5xx from tasks routed to canary variant 2.2-hotfix, latency also up. No obvious infra node OOMs yet.

Priya K: pinging infra and runtime team. If canary is implicated we should consider rollback to 2.1 and re-route traffic.

Jordan R: I can run rollback, prepping the command. Hold on.

sam (oncall): copying logs snippet for context:
```
[2026-03-14T20:10:12Z] model-runtime error: kvcache-mismatch: failed to read ctx
[2026-03-14T20:10:13Z] handler.go:495 response 500 for /v1/generate request_id=abc123
```

Jordan R: running rollback now - executing:
```bash
# rollback canary to stable 2.1
kubectl -n inference rollout undo deployment/model-service --to-revision=stable-2.1
# drain canary nodes from LB
kubectl patch svc model-svc -p '{"spec": {"sessionAffinity": "None"}}'
```

incident-bot: sam acknowledged at 1764003220. Jordan invoked rollback job JOB-789.

sam (oncall): rollback started, switching canary traffic to stable. Watching error-rate.

support-bot: Notifying support about affected customers: Acme Corp, Skylab Labs, NovaPay - ticket created: https://support.example/tickets/INC-9921

Priya K: escalate to second-level oncall if rollback doesn't reduce errors in 5m. Also send customer-facing heads-up if impact persists.

Maya S: I'm joining for handoff in 10. Will take over monitoring once rollback completes.

sam (oncall): rollback finished at ~20:18 UTC. Error rate dropping back to baseline in primary region. 5xx -> normal within 3 minutes.

sam (oncall): root cause preliminary: regression in model-runtime change in hotfix-2026-03-14 that mishandles KV-cache under certain seq lengths. Reproduced locally with canary payloads.

Priya K: good catch. Jordan, please open a PR revert and add a test for KV-cache path. Label as incident-related.

Jordan R: PR created: https://git.example/repo/infra/merge/5678 - includes unit test for cache path, rollout gated until green.

incident-bot: PagerDuty incident PD12345 resolved by sam at 1764003300 (status: resolved).

sam (oncall): handing off to Maya S for verification and postmortem. Summary for handoff:
- Issue: canary hotfix 2.2 caused KV-cache errors -> 5xxs on /v1/generate
- Mitigation: rollback canary to stable 2.1, drained canary nodes, error rate normalized
- Affected: subset of traffic on dedicated GPU pool, customers listed above; no data loss reported
- Next steps: Jordan to revert + tests, SRE to add alert for kvcache-mismatch, PM to notify affected customers if needed

Maya S: taking over. I'll monitor for one hour and create postmortem stub in #postmortems. Assigning action items to owners.

support-bot: Support notification sent to accounts team and CS. Template used: "We observed intermittent errors impacting generation, mitigation applied (rollback). We'll follow up with root cause and ETA for fix."

Priya K: thanks everyone. Please add timeline and logs to the incident ticket and mark priority = high. We'll do a quick RCA tomorrow AM. :white_check_mark:

Maya S: adding timeline to incident ticket and scheduling follow-up. Closing this thread but leaving PD link open for any re-escalation.

sam (oncall): sigh of relief. great coordination. :thumbsup:
